source_evidence.visual_inspection: Selected source frames were inspected to verify slide content and numerical readings. Extraction count is not inspection count.

technical_review.coverage: All chapter groups received a non-author review of selected derivations, assumptions, numerical calculations, and evidence links. Chapter depth and source-visual inspection vary.
technical_review.scope_limit: No full audiovisual or claim-by-claim transcription audit. Some tutorial cases reconstruct the analytical procedure using stated property values or independently constructed examples.
